variations.name: Two or Three Players
variations.description: Cards dealt as for four players; absent players' cards are dealt face up and played by the partners of the missing players.
variations.emptyOverridesReason: Variant only changes deal layout and who plays absent hands; no engine constant overrides needed.

variations.name: Zifuli
variations.description: Five-player version. Matto ranks between Nulla and Inn. Eight cards each in batches of four. Bidding to determine partnerships by naming a card; holder of other copy is partner. Lower card of same suit overcall. Bidder's side wins or loses stakes.
variations.emptyOverridesReason: Different player count and bidding; full overrides would need engine changes for five players and bid phase.

scoring.description: Point cards in won tricks; 19 points total per deal. Figure V-IX 0.5 each; Figure X and Matte XI-XV, Brescia 1 each.
scoring.winCondition: Partnership with 10 or more of 19 points wins the hand. Tie at 9.5 each broken by recount (82-point scale; 42 or more wins; 41-41 is no winner).
